chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān, from Muḥammad ibn Marwān, from Fuḍayl ibn Yasār, who said:

I heard Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام saying: Whoever dies while not having an Imam, then his death is a death of Jāhiliyyah. And whoever dies while knowing his Imam, it will not harm him whether this matter comes sooner or is delayed. And whoever dies while knowing his Imam is like one who is with al-Qāʾim in his tent.

key_terms.إِمَامٌ: the divinely appointed leader whose recognition is religiously necessary
key_terms.عَارِفٌ: one who recognizes and knows with conviction
key_terms.فِي فُسْطَاطِهِ: in his camp or tent, indicating closeness in rank and association
key_terms.مِيتَةُ جَاهِلِيَّةٍ: a death resembling the state of pre-Islamic ignorance and misguidance
key_terms.هَذَا الْأَمْرُ: the matter of the Imam's manifest rise and fulfillment

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith mean when it says that whoever dies without an Imam dies a death of Jāhiliyyah?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches that recognition of the rightful Imam is an essential matter of faith and religious authority. It states that one who dies knowing his Imam is not harmed by the delay or advance of the Imam's rise, and such a person holds the rank of one associated with al-Qāʾim.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Nomann, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, from Fuzayl Bin Yasar who said,

‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The one who dies there isn’t an Imam<sup>asws</sup> for him, so he would have died a death of the Pre-Islamic period (an unbeliever); and the one who dies while recognising his Imam<sup>asws</sup>, it would not harm him whether this matter is brought forwards or delayed; and the one who dies while recognising his Imam<sup>asws</sup> would be like the one who is with Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> in his<sup>asws</sup> tent’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Ni‘man from Muhammad ibn Marwan from al-Fudayl ibn Yasar who has said the following.

“I heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say, ‘One who would die without having an Imam his death would like the death of ignorance. One who would die and would know who his Imam is then the coming of this matter (the rise of al-Mahdi with Divine Authority) earlier or later will not affect him at all. One who would knowing who his Imam is he would be like the one present with Al-Qa’im in his tents.”
